title: Two-phase interruptible timeline: open, addPause() hinge, close
summary: One paused timeline: open half, `addPause()` at its duration `I`, close half; close calls `tl.time() < I ? tl.reverse() : tl.play()`, so a close mid-open rewinds from where it is and a close after the hinge plays the authored exit; reopen during the exit reverses back onto the pause; `pause(0)` on complete; the panel's visibility set at `.001` so `pause(0)` hides it; disclosure with `aria-expanded`, `inert` on close, Escape; opacity-only under reduced motion, `pause(I)` / `pause(0)` in the static tier
variants: any open/close pair: sheet, drawer, modal, accordion
